scientific_boundary.claim: This artifact narrows and reorganizes the proof obligations. It does not prove P=NP.

reverse_pass_question: If current JANUS could walk the entire historical path while already knowing the later failures, what would it refuse to do, what would it preserve, and what theorem would it target first?

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: After the scheduled eliminations, truth of the terminal representation must be decidable in polynomial time.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: Every admitted representation node must expose a tractable terminal/query interface; opaque compact nodes are forbidden.

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: Each scheduled variable elimination must preserve exact decision semantics.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: The representation language used on reachable states must support exact existential elimination/forgetting and normalization without leaving the tractable corridor.

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: Polynomially many locally polynomial transitions must compose to a polynomial total run in the original input size N.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: Prove a single input-relative polynomial envelope that is invariant under every scheduled reachable transition. Local polynomiality in current state size is insufficient.

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: The initial CNF must enter the tractable corridor without exponential compilation or hidden search.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: Use exact syntactic recognition and polynomial family-specific lanes where available; do not assume one fixed knowledge-compilation target is universally polynomial-size.

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: Cross-cut information must remain polynomially representable and manipulable.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: Measure exact residual/interface states and seek certified contractions/quotients before branching or materializing Cartesian products.

future_to_past_route.future_requirement: Every useful contraction/representation must be found, not merely verified, in polynomial total work.
future_to_past_route.backward_obligation: Charge discovery, failed proposals, representation bytes, nested manipulation, certificates and verification under one fixed exponent.

new_historical_anchors.role: Direct ancestor of exact existential variable elimination by resolution.
new_historical_anchors.lesson: Variable elimination is exact, but materializing all cross-resolvents can move the debt into representation size.
new_historical_anchors.source: Martin Davis and Hilary Putnam, A Computing Procedure for Quantification Theory, JACM 7(3), 1960, pp. 201-215.

new_historical_anchors.role: Canonical reduced ordered decision-DAG ancestor of exact residual-state quotienting.
new_historical_anchors.lesson: Canonical manipulation can be efficient relative to diagram size while worst-case diagram size remains exponential; variable order is a computational resource.
new_historical_anchors.source: Randal E. Bryant, Graph-Based Algorithms for Boolean Function Manipulation, IEEE Transactions on Computers, 1986.

new_historical_anchors.role: Knowledge-compilation map: representation languages are judged by succinctness plus supported polynomial-time queries and transformations.
new_historical_anchors.lesson: Compactness and operational tractability are separate obligations.
new_historical_anchors.source: Adnan Darwiche and Pierre Marquis, A Knowledge Compilation Map, JAIR 17, 2002.

new_historical_anchors.lesson: Closure under a transformation is useful only together with size/query guarantees; binary local closure must not be promoted to an unproved global composition theorem.
new_historical_anchors.source: Pierre Marquis, Existential Closures for Knowledge Compilation, IJCAI 2011.

new_historical_anchors.role: Negative control against treating one fixed compiled language as universal salvation.
new_historical_anchors.lesson: There are polynomial-size CNF families requiring exponential DNNF representations, so arbitrary-CNF polynomial compilation to DNNF cannot be assumed.
new_historical_anchors.source: Bova, Capelli, Mengel, Slivovsky, A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas.

new_historical_anchors.role: Boundary-width characterization of tractable compilation on structural classes.
new_historical_anchors.lesson: Width can govern exact state explosion, but finding or preserving a small-width representation is itself a charged resource.
new_historical_anchors.source: Work on knowledge compilation, width and quantification including Amarilli/Monet/Senellart and Capelli/Mengel.

central_new_correction.bad_inference: For every step, size(S_{i+1}) and work_i are polynomial in size(S_i), therefore a polynomial number of steps is polynomial in original N.
central_new_correction.counterexample_recurrence: s_0=N; s_{i+1}=s_i^2 gives s_i=N^(2^i), despite every individual transition being polynomial in its current input size.

global_polynomial_envelope_invariance.envelope: B(N)=N^c for one fixed universal c
requirements: INITIAL: encoded state S0 is within B(N).
REACHABLE_PRESERVATION: for every state reachable under the frozen algorithm, if S is within B(N), the scheduled exact transition plus normalization returns S' within B(N).
STEP_WORK: transition, normalization, certificate production and verification are bounded by fixed polynomials in original N while the envelope holds.
STEP_COUNT: the frozen schedule performs at most polynomially many macrosteps in N.
TERMINAL: the terminal representation has an exact polynomial-time truth query.
NO_HIDDEN_DEBT: auxiliary semantic variables, DAG nodes, contexts, boundary states, bit-length, certificate bytes and failed discovery work are all counted.
global_polynomial_envelope_invariance.conditional_lemma: If the above requirements hold for arbitrary CNF under one fixed deterministic JANUS algorithm, then total runtime is polynomial by induction over the scheduled steps; hence SAT is in P.

pirc_refinement.old_question: Does every local operation have a polynomial implementation on the current representation?
pirc_refinement.new_question: Does one fixed deterministic JANUS trajectory remain inside a single input-relative polynomial envelope of exact tractable representations for all reachable states?
pirc_refinement.name: PIRC_WITH_GPEI

typed_corridor_candidate.name: TYPED_TRACTABLE_BLOCK_DAG_WITH_RESIDUAL_INTERFACE_QUOTIENTS
typed_corridor_candidate.principle: Two boundary states may be merged only by a syntactic canonical rule, a tractable canonical representation, or an independently checkable exact quotient/congruence certificate whose discovery cost is charged.

reverse_pass_repairs_to_prior_path: At C024 residual caching, install an input-relative global state envelope before interpreting local cache operations as a complexity route.
At Policy0A, use the future-known starvation counterfamily to reject early-pivot scheduling immediately and adopt the fair scheduler from the start.
At proof-carrying reasons, distinguish verifier cost from proof discovery before treating certificate existence as an algorithmic resource.
At B2/ER, mark global p-boundedness as an external proof-complexity frontier immediately rather than trying to brute-force it locally.
At factorized resolution, run exact family recognition before generic factoring; PHP enters the matching/Hall lane and bypasses the 105-resolvent wall.
At canonical sharing, distinguish syntactic equality, restricted canonical equality and arbitrary semantic equivalence; never use semantic equality as a free merge primitive.
At ROBDD/live-width lanes, treat boundary width/order as explicit resources and charge discovery of a good representation.
At every stage, use M2R only to forecast the first future envelope violation; admission still requires exact proof/certificate checks.

hostile_next_controls.purpose: Test whether a proposed universal representation is merely DNNF/OBDD-style compilation under another name.
hostile_next_controls.expected_rule: A lower bound against one representation language rejects that lane only, not JANUS as a whole.

hostile_next_controls.purpose: Construct traces where every step is polynomial in current size but repeated composition leaves every fixed input-relative polynomial envelope.
Separate existence of a small exact boundary quotient from polynomial-time discovery of it.

next_exact_target.name: GPEI_PRESERVATION_FOR_TYPED_REACHABLE_CORRIDOR
next_exact_target.question: For the frozen JANUS schedule and typed exact lanes, can every reachable transition either preserve one fixed B(N)=N^c envelope or fail closed before exceeding it?
success_requires: one fixed exponent c independent of instance
polynomial recognition/discovery of the selected typed lane
polynomial total bytes and verifier work
